title: Salsa Roja

items: 2 serrano chili, seeds and stem removed

steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil.
Remove the stems and seeds from the chiles and add them to the boiling water. The source leaves the boiling time unspecified.
Add all the ingredients to a blender
reviewFlags: The source omits the quantities for guajillo and ancho chiles and leaves the boiling time unfinished.
